added.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Principal
added.description:
We are PMG

PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. With more than 1,000 employees, PMG partners with brands including Apple, Nike, Dropbox, Experian, Sephora, and Whole Foods. Our work has earned top industry honors, including Cannes Lions and Adweek’s Media Plan of the Year, and PMG has won 40+ workplace culture awards, including being the only company to rank among Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for 11 consecutive years.

Who You Will Be Working With

You’ll be part of PMG’s Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE)
team of senior, customer-facing engineers that operate at the intersection of business problems, technology, and platform innovation
.

FDE partners deeply with priority customers, Vertical leaders, Client Strategy, Analytics, Product, and Engineering to solve complex, high-impact challenges that don’t fit standard playbooks. The team builds custom technical solutions, within the PMG Operating System (Alli), sometimes integrating with Alli from a sandbox environment, and sometimes outside the platform entirely. Remaining focused on driving meaningful business outcomes and shaping what becomes scalable over time.

This is a small, senior group designed for depth over breadth, operating where clarity is earned through execution, not documentation.

What You’ll Be Doing

As a Forward Deployed Engineering Principal
, you will operate as a senior individual contributor with enterprise-level influence. Your work will center on solving real customer business problems through technology, not maintaining or extending a predefined product roadmap.

Partner deeply with priority customers and PMG leadership to understand material business challenges, constraints, and opportunities.
Translate ambiguous business problems into clear technical approaches and working solutions.
Design and deliver custom technical solutions across data, measurement, workflows, mobile, and platform integrations.
Operate hands-on in solution design and build, using modern tools, AI-assisted coding, and best practices to move quickly without sacrificing quality.
Advise customers and internal teams on feasibility, tradeoffs, and technical direction.
Identify patterns, learnings, and approaches that can inform reusable accelerators or future platform capabilities.
Influence product and platform evolution by feeding validated insights back into PMG’s broader technology ecosystem.
Support high-impact moments such as strategic pitches, QBRs, and new business efforts where technical clarity materially changes the outcome.
Use AI, automation, and technology to elevate the quality and efficiency of work, streamline processes, and enable faster, more informed decision-making in your role.

What You’ll Bring

We’re not looking for a traditional software engineer profile. We’re looking for someone who is technically fluent, business-curious, and comfortable building in ambiguity
.

You’ll be successful in this role if you bring:

Strong technical literacy and the ability to design, evaluate, and build solutions without needing to be the deepest specialist in any single language or framework.
Experience solving real business problems with technology, not just implementing predefined requirements.
Comfort working across systems, data flows, APIs, and platforms, including modern cloud and measurement environments.
8+ year experience in customer-facing or consultative technical roles (e.g., forward deployed engineering, solutions architecture, technical consulting, sales engineering, or similar).
The ability to reason about tradeoffs, feasibility, and risk when the “right answer” isn’t obvious.
A bias toward execution: you’re comfortable moving from problem to prototype to production quickly.
Familiarity with AI-assisted and agentic coding tools, and the judgment to use them effectively within standards and best practices.
Strong communication skills, especially the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
A track record of influencing decisions without direct authority.
Curiosity, adaptability, and comfort operating where the path to value isn’t fully defined upfront.
An understanding that reuse, scale, and platform contribution are earned through impact—not assumed at the start.

What We Offer

Performance-Based Rewards:
Your impact should be part of your reward. This role is eligible for PMG’s annual bonus program—a standout part of our total compensation offering and an opportunity to share in our success. Bonus awards are informed by individual impact and performance, as well as team and company results, and are subject to applicable program terms.

Professional Development:
Keep growing through learning and development programs, mentorship opportunities, and support for career advancement.

Generous Time Off:
Take the time you need to recharge, connect with loved ones, and enjoy life outside work.

Parental Leave:
Receive paid parental leave during life’s important family moments.

Retirement Benefits:
Build for your future with competitive retirement benefits, including employer contributions or matching where applicable.

Fertility and Family Support:
Access fertility and family-building benefits for eligible employees and their spouses or partners.

Healthcare:
Choose from medical, dental, and vision coverage designed to support you and your family.

Pet Insurance:
Access optional coverage for the four-legged members of your family.

Lifestyle Spending Account:
Receive company-funded support for eligible health and well-being expenses.

Commuter Benefits:
Access support for your commute where available.

Volunteering Opportunities:
Receive eight paid hours each year to give back to your community.

AI Tools and Training:
Access enterprise AI tools and ongoing training that helps PMGers use AI effectively, creatively, and responsibly.

Our benefits and compensation programs may vary by location and eligibility and are subject to applicable plan terms. We’ll share full details during the hiring process.

What Sets Us Apart

Being part of PMG means joining a company culture that’s unmatched in digital. We're dedicated to working hard to serve our employees and clients, delivering value, results, and innovation—which often requires true grit and agility. We believe in taking care of ourselves and each other to continuously improve in every way.

In alignment with our core values to be inclusive and always change for the better, PMG is committed to creating a more diverse and inclusive culture, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe that we only change for the better by bringing diverse perspectives to our company. PMG recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

added.title: Senior Software Engineer, Finance Technology (Forward Deployed)
added.description:
Position Summary

Vista Equity Partners is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to serve as the forward deployed engineer for thefirm's Finance organization. This individual contributor role, at the Associate level, sits on Enterprise AI & Automation and reports to the Director, AI Solutions Engineering, but works embedded day to day with the Finance Technology team. The engineer learns how Finance works, finds the problems worth solving, and ships production software on Vista's AI platform, from treasury and close tooling to AI experiences over curated finance data. They also partner with the technologists already building inside Finance, so that what the department builds meets platform standards and can run in production. The team works primarily in TypeScript, Node.js, and Reacton Azure, using modern AI tooling throughout the development workflow.

This role can be fully remote within the US or based in our Austin office.

Responsibilities

Embed with Finance as its dedicated engineer: join the team's working rhythms, learn its workflows across areas such as fund accounting, treasury, tax, and the financial close, and build trust with finance stakeholders.
Turn loosely defined finance problems into product requirements and design documents, and break the workinto deliverable pieces.
Design, build, and operate finance applications, automations, and AI experiences end to end on Vista's platform, integrating systems such as Snowflake, SharePoint, and Smartsheet.
Partner with Finance Technology's department technologists: share platform capabilities and patterns,review their code and designs, pair on harder problems, and help their work plug into platform standards instead of running in parallel.
Bring the most useful finance apps built by business users (for example, in Replit) onto Vista's enterprise platform, up to its security, SDLC, and operational standards.
Lead user testing, rollouts, and go-lives with finance owners, managing scope, tradeoffs, status, and adoption directly.
Own shipped software, including releases, defects, and ongoing iteration, with the accuracy, auditability, and data security that financial workflows require.
Bring Finance's needs back to Enterprise AI & Automation, flagging platform gaps and reusable patterns witha recommendation.
Use modern AI tooling throughout delivery while holding all shipped code to a high bar of review and quality.
Participate in on-call rotation for production applications and platform services.

Qualifications

Technical Skills

6+ years of software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated scope.
Production experience with TypeScript and Node.js, including designing and operating APIs.
Track record of owning software in production after launch, including support, defects, and iteration.
Strong SQL and experience building on a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake preferred), including access controls and data quality checks.
Cloud-native delivery on a major cloud platform (Azure preferred), including infrastructure as code, CI/CD,identity, and observability.
Established AI-native engineering practice, using AI coding tools well beyond autocomplete to ship production software.
Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Domain Knowledge

Working familiarity with private equity finance, such as fund structures, capital calls and distributions,management fees and carried interest, fund accounting, and investor reporting. Deep expertise is not required.
Comfort learning finance workflows quickly and speaking the language of accountants, controllers, and treasury teams.

Soft Skills

Excellent written and verbal communication, including explaining technical tradeoffs to finance leaders.
Enjoys working inside a business team: listens first, learns the work, and earns trust by shipping.
Product mindset, with experience taking a product or feature set from zero to adoption and understanding the business reasons behind the code.
Experience working directly with non-technical stakeholders on requirements, tradeoffs, and rollouts.
Collaborative mindset, with the ability to raise the work of technical colleagues outside engineering through review and pairing.
Comfortable with ambiguity, change, and a high degree of autonomy.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in private equity, fund administration, or financial services technology.
Forward deployed, solutions engineering, or other customer-embedded engineering experience.
Experience with fund accounting, treasury, or ERP systems and their APIs.
Hands-on experience building generative AI applications, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and evaluating answer quality.
Experience supporting or governing citizen developer or low-code populations.
React or Terraform.
Experience with agent frameworks or Model Context Protocol (MCP).

The annualized base pay range for this role is expected to be between $95,000 - $180,000. Actual base pay could vary based on factors including but not limited to experience, subject matter expertise, geographic location where work will be performed and the applicant’s skill set. The base pay is just one component of the total compensation package for employees. Other components may include an annual cash bonus and a comprehensive benefits package.

Vista is a preeminent technology investor, specializing in enterprise AI and software, with over $100 billion in AUM. For over 25 years and across every technology cycle, Vista has been pioneering new approaches to software investing, delivering consistent and compelling results at scale. Today, we're applying that expertise to help harness the transformative potential of AI to redefine how work gets done. Further information is available at vistaequitypartners.com . We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.

Job Description

Remote

Lenovo Solutions Services Group is running a company-wide AI transformation program, embedding engineering talent directly inside business functions. Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) are the builders at the center of that model.

As an FDE, you will be assigned to a specific business function and work alongside its leaders and teams to identify where AI creates real leverage, then build and deploy practical solutions that fit how work actually gets done. This is not a research or advisory role — you move from discovery to working prototype to deployed solution within sprint cycles, in close partnership with a Domain Leader who provides business direction and context.

The right candidate is energized by driving meaningful change in a business — not just shipping code but making sure what gets built is genuinely adopted and used. You are comfortable working with typical tech stacks such as Microsoft and ServiceNow as well as building custom AI agents/ solutions on other internal platforms.

What You Will Do

Discover and Define

Embed in a business function and work with the Domain Leader and subject matter experts to map workflows, surface pain points, and identify high-value AI opportunities.
Translate business problems into scoped, deliverable use cases — balancing ambition with what is practical to build and adopt.

Build and Deploy

Design and build AI solutions using the right tools for the problem: Microsoft AI and productivity platforms (Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, M365), RAG pipelines, agent workflows, automation tooling, and custom development where needed.
Prototype quickly, test with real users, and iterate within short sprint cycles.
Deliver solutions that integrate into existing workflows — not standalone demos.

Drive Adoption and Impact

Own adoption as well as technical delivery — work alongside change resources to help teams actually use what gets built.
Gather feedback post-deployment to improve performance and increase business value over time.
Contribute to patterns and practices that can scale across squads and functions.

Communicate and Collaborate

Bridge business stakeholders, data teams, and platform partners — translating clearly in both directions.
Provide concise, honest updates on progress, risks, and tradeoffs to technical and senior non-technical audiences alike.

Required

What We’re Looking For

5+ years in software engineering, solutions engineering, applied AI, or a closely related technical role.
Hands-on experience building and deploying AI, automation, or intelligent workflow solutions in real business settings.
Strong working knowledge of LLMs, prompt design, retrieval-based architectures, orchestration, and agent-based systems.
Comfortable integrating with enterprise APIs, data sources, and workflow platforms.
A genuine drive to see change land — you understand that building the solution is only half the job.
Clear communicator; able to explain technical decisions in plain language to business and leadership audiences.

Preferred

Experience with Microsoft AI platforms: Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, M365, Power Platform.
Custom development skills (Python, JavaScript, or similar) for problems that off-the-shelf tooling cannot solve.
Background in technical consulting, solutions architecture, or customer-facing engineering.
Experience with change enablement, user adoption, or process redesign alongside technical delivery.

What Success Looks Like

Working solutions in users’ hands at the end of each sprint — not decks or proofs of concept.
Measurable business outcomes: time saved, processes improved, decisions made faster.
A team that has adopted the tools and can articulate the impact.
A function that can operate and evolve its AI solutions after the engagement ends.

What to expect during your interview: Our virtual interviews are conducted on camera to support an engaging and consistent interview experience. Please ensure you have access to a camera, audio, and reliable internet connectivity. If you are unable to participate on camera, please let your recruiter know in advance.

Candidates who progress to the final stage of the selection process for fully remote roles will be invited to complete their final interview in person to learn more about Lenovo, meet key stakeholders, and experience our workplace and culture firsthand.

We offer flexibility in where you work! This role is eligible for remote work. If you live within commuting distance of our Chicago, IL or Raleigh, NC offices, you'll enjoy a hybrid schedule with three days in the office and two days working from home each week. If you're located outside of these areas, you'll have the opportunity to work remotely, based on business needs.

Description

As a key technical leader, you will own the architecture and delivery of the high-availability, low-latency AI platform that powers intelligent capabilities across Brivo's core access control and video products. This requires a proactive approach to system ownership—not only implementing features but also defining the technical roadmap for LLM orchestration, tooling, and agent infrastructure, driving architectural discussions on AI safety and reliability, and providing technical guidance to the team. You will directly own the underlying services, integrations, streaming pipelines, and guardrail systems that make generative AI safe and dependable in production. Our best engineers are adept at picking up new things, enjoy solving challenging problems, speak up, and thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

You will join a high-impact team dedicated to building the next generation of AI-powered experiences on Brivo's platform. This team helps Brivo customers derive value from their access control and video systems by making buildings and their data intelligible and actionable through AI—developing platform capabilities ranging from multi-agent orchestration and LLM safety guardrails to tool/MCP servers, real-time streaming, and deep platform integrations.

Responsibilities

Design, build, and operate MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and tool registries that expose platform capabilities to LLMs and agents safely and reliably.
Deliver generative AI capabilities across the platform—prompt engineering, tool/function calling, agent routing, and stateful human-in-the-loop workflows—that are safe, responsive, and cost-efficient.
Build and maintain AI safety guardrails (prompt-injection, data-exposure, and relevance/abuse detection) and resumable tool workflows using Redis-backed checkpointing.
Spend approximately 70% of your time coding. This includes architecting and developing scalable, production-grade API and platform services primarily utilizing Node.js/TypeScript and Express for containerized and serverless (AWS Lambda) delivery, backed by an LLM-driven multi-agent orchestration framework.
Drive technical design, document key decisions (e.g., Architecture Decision Records - ADRs), and participate rigorously in code reviews and design sessions to maintain the highest quality engineering standards.
Own the cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines, utilizing AWS (Lambda, SQS, Secrets Manager, SSM), CI/CD tooling, feature flags (LaunchDarkly), and externalized configuration (Spring Cloud Config) to automate provisioning and ensure continuous integration and delivery.
Collaborate effectively with product managers and designers to design and deliver high-quality features. Work within an Agile team to complete sprint planning, backlog grooming, feature reviews, and closely support your Team Lead with project scoping.
Troubleshoot and resolve complex, high-impact production issues, taking full responsibility for application ownership. Proactively identify security vulnerabilities, harden service-to-service auth and rate limiting, and optimize database performance and data models within PostgreSQL.
Set a high bar for engineering excellence and serve as a technical mentor to team members, driving process improvements and promoting best practices across the engineering department.
Partner with other teams across the organization to support the company's mission through architectural and technical improvements.

Qualifications

Required
5+ years of professional experience designing, developing, and deploying highly available, scalable software solutions.
5+ years of deep, hands-on experience with Node.js and TypeScript, including serverless development on AWS Lambda.
Direct experience building and operating MCP servers (or comparable LLM tool/plugin servers) in production.
Proven experience building production REST API services with Express (or equivalent), including authentication, rate limiting, input validation, and OpenAPI/Swagger documentation.
Hands-on experience developing LLM-enabled / generative AI applications—tool calling, multi-agent orchestration, and prompt engineering.
Strong experience with AWS, containerized deployments, and CI/CD tools.
Deep practical experience with relational databases, specifically PostgreSQL, and query optimization.
Experience with real-time streaming (Server-Sent Events and/or message queues such as AWS SQS) and Redis for state management.
BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is preferred.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Highly Desirable Skills
Direct experience developing AI-enabled services, familiarity with LLM provider APIs (e.g., Anthropic Claude, OpenAI), and advanced context/prompt engineering techniques.
Experience designing AI safety guardrails (prompt-injection defense, data-exposure prevention) and human-in-the-loop confirmation flows for sensitive operations.
Experience authoring and scaling MCP server ecosystems—tool/resource design, transport, and access control for agent-facing APIs.
Experience with schema-validation libraries (e.g., Zod), feature-flagging platforms (LaunchDarkly), and externalized configuration (Spring Cloud Config).
Familiarity with agent-orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain/LangGraph or equivalent) and LLM evaluation, tracing, and cost/latency optimization.
Deep expertise in authentication and authorization, including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, and role-based access control for secure, multi-tenant enterprise platforms.
Domain experience in physical security, access control, or IoT platforms.

Why Work for Us?

Brivo is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and the global leader in cloud-based access control and video surveillance. Following our merger with Eagle Eye Networks, we are building the only platform powerful enough to support the future of AI-driven security.

Why Your Work Matters

Innovation drives our vibe, but purpose drives our mission. You will work on essential systems that protect the health, safety, and welfare of people and property worldwide. At Brivo, your voice is heard, your talent is respected, and your contributions have a global impact. The Brivo Experience: We thrive on in-person collaboration and a "one-team" atmosphere. We embrace our international presence, leveraging diverse ideas and backgrounds to improve our culture and our products. To keep our global teams connected and inspired, we provide a premium onsite experience featuring communal meals, recurring social events, and fully stocked workspaces—ensuring you have everything you need to stay focused while building the future of security.
Total Rewards: We support our people with competitive medical, vision, and dental plans (including company-offset premiums), a 401k with company match, and an unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) policy that empowers you to take the time you need to maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Individual compensation packages are based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, training, and market conditions. In addition, Brivonians enjoy a robust benefits and perks package tailored to their work location.

About Brivo

Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category-defining, cloud-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single-site businesses to global enterprises.

As the unified global leaders in cloud-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. By combining Brivo’s pioneering building access platform with Eagle Eye’s AI-powered video management system (VMS), we have created a system of intelligence that protects over 600 million square feet across 90+ countries. Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure.

With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com.

As a Forward Deployed Software Engineer-Palantir Foundry-Senior Associate, you will leverage advanced technologies and techniques to design and develop robust data solutions for clients. This opportunity allows you to use a broad range of tools, methodologies, and techniques to generate new ideas and solve problems, while developing a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is evolving.

Utilize proficiency in data engineering and analytics to drive client benefits
Manage client accounts and foster enduring client relationships
Taking ownership of projects, including planning, budgeting, and execution
Encouraging innovation and technology adoption to enhance delivery
Addressing conflicts and engaging in challenging conversations with stakeholders
Upholding professional and technical standards, including PwC's code of conduct
Identify opportunities for team development and continuous improvement

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 3 years of experience

Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Analytics/Data Science, Artificial Intelligence/Robotics, Computer Science/Information Systems, Engineering

added.title: AI Engineer/Forward engineer
added.description:
Job Description

AI Engineer/Forward engineer

Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

Preferred Qualifications
Experience building enterprise AI applications using OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or similar LLMs.
Hands-on experience with LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or comparable frameworks.
Experience deploying production-grade AI agents and RAG solutions.
Knowledge of AI observability, evaluation, and monitoring tools.
Experience implementing secure, governed, and scalable AI solutions.
Desired Competencies
Strong problem-solving and system design skills.
Ability to translate business requirements into AI-powered solutions.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional teams.
Passion for emerging AI technologies and continuous learning.

Roles & Responsibilities

We are seeking an innovative Agentic AI Engineer / Forward Deployed AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) to solve real-world business challenges. This role focuses on building intelligent agentic systems and production-grade AI solutions rather than training foundation models.
The ideal candidate will have expertise in AI application development, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), orchestration frameworks, and scalable AI services. You will work closely with business stakeholders and engineering teams to deliver reusable AI capabilities that automate repetitive tasks and enhance operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Agentic AI Engineering
Design and develop autonomous AI agent workflows capable of executing multi-step business processes.
Build AI systems around foundation models without requiring model training or pre-training.
Develop advanced prompt engineering and context engineering strategies to improve AI performance and reliability.
Implement tool use, function calling, and API integrations for AI agents.
Build agent orchestration using frameworks such as LangGraph, agent loops, planners, and multi-agent architectures.
Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using vector databases.
Fward Deployed AI Engineering
Partner with business stakeholders to identify AI use cases and rapidly develop production-ready AI applications.
Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications using modern LLM frameworks.
Build scalable RAG pipelines for enterprise knowledge retrieval.
Optimize prompts, workflows, and evaluation frameworks to improve AI solution quality.
Develop reusable AI services, APIs, and components that can be leveraged across multiple teams.
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise systems, data sources, and business applications.
Support deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement of AI applications in production.

Salary Range- $100,000-$120,000 a year

Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced Generative AI Engineer with proven expertise in designing, developing, deploying, and supporting AI solutions in production environments. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, AI agents, vector databases, and cloud based AI platforms. The candidate should have successfully delivered enterprise-grade GenAI applications used by business users in production.

Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI solutions for enterprise business use cases.
Build and maintain production-ready applications utilizing LLMs such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, or similar models.
Develop RAG-based solutions using vector databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, ChromaDB, or Azure AI Search.
Implement prompt engineering, prompt tuning, and model evaluation frameworks.
Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and cloud platforms.
Monitor production AI applications for performance, accuracy, latency, and cost optimization.
Design AI agents and workflow automation using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or Semantic Kernel.
Implement responsible AI controls, security, governance, and compliance requirements.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, data scientists, and engineering teams to deliver scalable AI solutions.

added.title: AI Engineer
added.description:
Deliver robust, tested and supportable systems from the team's working prototypes to R&D scientists. The Associate Director is the team's senior full-stack engineer and architect. The role owns the engineering standards, development and deployment patterns, and production readiness for every application the team ships, and decides how software built with agentic tools by scientists and colleagues becomes durable, validation-ready systems. Its decisions set how quickly prototypes become products, how reliable those products are, and whether they are ready for validation. The role partners with a peer Associate Director, AI Platform & Enablement, who turns proven team patterns into shared platform capabilities over time. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role: the Associate Director designs, builds, debugs and reviews production software, working in agentic development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) throughout the day, alongside validated-system work that follows its own procedures.

Responsibilities:

-
Own engineering standards and production readiness for every application the team ships. Select and maintain the team's standard languages, frameworks and supported versions based on security, maintainability, enterprise compatibility and what AI-assisted development builds most reliably. Make architecture, release and incident-response decisions without escalation, within agreed governance, security and quality requirements.
-
Take prototypes built by scientists and colleagues with agentic tools to production grade: refactor, strengthen and productize them with sound architecture, tests, observability, security, documentation and operability. Assess prototypes against agreed engineering standards and work with stakeholders to recommend and implement retain, rebuild or retire decisions.
-
Own application-to-platform integration: the production concerns that recur across applications, such as authentication and single sign-on, secrets, networking, deployment and monitoring. Solve them for the team, build them once into reusable patterns, and work with the AI Platform & Enablement Associate Director and enterprise platform teams to move proven patterns into the platform.
-
Establish and maintain the team's standard development and deployment patterns: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments, starter templates, monitoring and operational runbooks for the team's applications and agents.
-
Own code-review standards and the merge gate for the team's repositories, reviewing and approving changes from scientists, colleagues, contractors and embedded delivery engineers, none of whom report to the role. Run design and architecture reviews before applications enter shared environments, and set the review standard for AI-generated code.
-
Design and build full-stack, cloud-native systems: APIs, orchestration and workflow services, data and vector stores, identity and access, and scientist-facing front ends, favoring managed services and simple, maintainable designs.
-
Partner with Quality and computer system validation colleagues to define and implement risk-based engineering and validation practices for LLM and agent-based applications, and build the evidence case for them. Practices may include requirements traceability, model and configuration change control, regression evaluations, controlled releases and auditable records. Quality retains decision authority.
-
Work directly with R&D scientists and the team's scientists to define software requirements, review their code and build engineering capability through pairing. Lead the productization of the team's flagship applications, directing embedded delivery or professional-services engineers and coaching colleagues on engineering practice.
-
Gain acceptance from platform teams and Cyber for the team's deployment and access patterns. Implement application security practice in line with Cyber standards, and ensure the team's applications and delivery practice comply with the company's quality management system, security guidelines and IT policies.
-
Own the production-support approach for the team's applications, including triage, escalation, incident follow-up and engineering fixes, with support responsibilities agreed across the team and platform partners.
-
Bring production-readiness and risk assessments to senior leadership, with recommendations on build versus buy and on which prototypes to harden or retire.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in a physical, life or quantitative science or in engineering, or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred.
10+ years building and operating production software, with a substantial share as a hands-on architect or principal-level engineer who thinks in systems.
Experience building or operating software in regulated, validated environments (e.g., GxP, computer system validation, IQ/OQ/PQ, requirements traceability) required.
Demonstrated, sustained daily use of agentic development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) to design, build and ship software, with full ownership of generated code, evidenced by delivered software, professional or personal.
Experience owning CI/CD, infrastructure as code and release engineering with a globally distributed team: pipelines, environments, deployment and rollback, and observability.
Track record of taking inherited or prototype code to production grade: refactoring, test coverage, security hardening, performance and operability.
Experience solving the production concerns that sit between applications and platforms (e.g., authentication and SSO, secrets, networking, access control) and turning them into reusable patterns.
Fluency in at least one production language and the judgment to direct agents across a polyglot stack (the team's is Python, TypeScript and PostgreSQL).
Deep cloud-native experience, AWS preferred (equivalent Azure or GCP depth considered): containers and serverless, workflow orchestration, IAM and least-privilege design, managed data stores.
Hands-on LLM application patterns (RAG, vector search, multi-stage pipelines) preferred.
Experience working directly with research scientists preferred.

About CSL Behring

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits

For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL

At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.
To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

This enterprise-wide digital service allows organizations to build, test, host, operate, and integrate mission-driven applications, data, and emerging technologies. Background in working with the large scale clusters

added.description:
Organizational Context

The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC) is the world’s largest humanitarian network, with 191 member National Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies. IFRC uses the Triple R – response, resilience and respect – to deliver on Strategy 2030. IFRC responds to disasters and crises, ensuring timely, coordinated and locally led humanitarian action. IFRC supports its members in building community resilience in the areas of climate and environment, health and wellbeing, and migration and displacement. IFRC promotes respect for our fundamental principles of humanity, impartiality, neutrality, independence, voluntary service, unity, and universality, including in our work on values, power and inclusion. The IFRC focuses throughout on our core mandate – our raison d’être – of strategic and operational coordination, humanitarian diplomacy, National Society development, and accountability.

IFRC is led by its Secretary General and has its Headquarters in Geneva and five regional offices in Africa (Nairobi); the Americas (Panama); Asia Pacific (Kuala Lumpur); Europe (Budapest); and MENA (Beirut) as well as representation offices, service centres and delegations across the globe.

IFRC is led by its Secretary General, and has its Headquarters in Geneva, Switzerland. IFRC has five regional offices in Africa, Asia Pacific, Middle East and North Africa, Europe, and the Americas. IFRC also has country cluster delegations and country delegations throughout the world. Together, the Geneva Headquarters and the field structure (regional, cluster and country) comprise the IFRC Secretariat.

IFRC has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment and other forms of harassment, abuse of authority, discrimination, and lack of integrity (including but not limited to financial misconduct). IFRC also adheres to strict child safeguarding principles.

Background to the position

In virtually all countries, people increasingly rely on and expect a diverse range of digital services (e.g., through their mobile devices) to interact with local government, companies, and community organizations and services. This disruption is already happening to humanitarian assistance. Yet, the Digital Divide remains a persistent and significant challenge at both national and local levels.

The need for a successful and large-scale digital transformation is urgent. And Digitally Transforming the IFRC and its 191 members is a complex process which requires collaborative action and support across the membership. Therefore, the IFRC recently developed a Digital Transformation Strategy which was approved by the IFRC Governing Board in May 2021.  

The Digital Transformation Department (DTD) has full leadership responsibility for the implementation of the digital transformation strategy and the positive impact it will have on the 191 National Society members of the IFRC. The DTD provides strategic leadership and guides the IFRC Secretariat as well as the members network to adapt and innovate humanitarian services, drawing on digital services, data-enabled decision-making, and other opportunities for digital transformation in support of the IFRC’s Strategy 2030. In addition, the DTD is responsible for the development and implementation of business transformation, information technology and digitalization services throughout the IFRC Secretariat, thereby supporting the same transformation in 191 NSs, setting the vision, and drawing stakeholders together on this digital journey. 

Job Purpose

The incumbent reports to the AI and Data management unit (“AI & Data unit”), that is accountable to the Director of the DTD. The other units and teams reporting to the DT Director include the Enterprise Architecture, Strategy & Planning unit, the Digital development and management unit, the Infrastructure & Security Team and the Global Service Desk and Endpoint Management team. Under the leadership of the Director, these units and teams serve as members of the global DTD management team, along with the CISO and Regional DT managers.

The AI & Data unit is responsible to deliver greater value from IFRC’s data, and ensures the development and implementation of IFRCs data and AI governance and strategy, in close collaboration with the IFRC’s Data Protection Office and through indirect management of data professionals in other departments. The unit oversees all data operations, data product lifecycles and manages the organisation’s data platform, as well as the coordination and support to AI initiatives.

The Senior Officer, AI Platform Engineering will also interact with internal and external AI and data experts, private sector, academia, external suppliers, vendors and consultants who are sourced to deliver AI-related activities.

Job Purpose

The Senior Officer, AI Platform Engineering builds and runs the shared platform that IFRC teams use to create AI solutions on Microsoft technologies. The role provisions and operates Azure AI services, supports colleagues who build agents in Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365 Copilot, and makes it easy for teams to build AI that is secure, compliant and affordable.

The role puts into practice the IFRC security and governance standards, and works closely with developers, data protection colleagues and IT operations across the Secretariat.

Job Duties And Responsibilities

Azure AI Platform Operations
Operate and maintain IFRC's Microsoft-based AI platforms and services (e.g. Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI and related Azure services, Copilot Studio and Power Platform) across development, testing and production environments.
Configure and maintain platform components and integrations to support the deployment and operation of AI applications and services.
Develop and maintain version-controlled infrastructure-as-code templates for AI platform resources, automate environment provisioning and identify and remediate configuration drift against approved baselines.
Manage model deployments, quotas and capacity, and track model retirements so that applications keep working when models are updated or withdrawn.
Ensure proper life-cycle management of AI related services.
Monitor platform availability, performance, resource utilization and operational costs, identifying opportunities for optimization.
Maintain resource tagging and usage attribution by team or solution, configure budget and abnormal-consumption alerts, provide cost and capacity forecasts, and coordinate the removal or resizing of unused resources with their owners.
Operate the AI gateway in Azure API Management, including authentication, rate limits per team, load balancing, and usage logging.
Troubleshoot platform and deployment issues, investigate incidents and implement corrective actions within the scope of the role.
Support for developers and makers
Build and maintain reusable templates, reference architectures and code samples for common patterns, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agents built with Foundry Agent Service or the Microsoft Agent Framework.
Support colleagues building AI applications and agents in Azure AI Foundry, building agents in Copilot Studio and extending Microsoft 365 Copilot, including environment setup, connectors and publishing.
Build and maintain the pipelines that connect AI services to IFRC data in SharePoint, Microsoft Fabric, Dataverse and other sources.
Onboard new teams to the platform, answer their technical questions and keep its documentation clear and current.
Collaborates with the team in developing and providing to the organization trainings and learning materials related to AI with a focus on platform and security.

Job Duties And Responsibilities (continued)

AI Workload Operations and Security
Build, maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines for AI applications and related platform components, including version control, automated testing, deployment and release management.
Develop and apply established operational practices for managing AI workloads, including appropriate resource allocation and environment configuration.
Implement established security configurations and operational procedures for AI workloads.
Implement and maintain approved Azure Policy and network security guardrails for AI services, including permitted deployment regions, private connectivity, restrictions on public access and approved authentication methods; monitor compliance and track exceptions through the agreed review process.
Monitor relevant Azure security alerts and recommendations affecting AI workloads (e.g. Defender for Cloud) and coordinate follow-up actions.
Apply established identity and access management practices for applications and workloads, including secure credential and secrets management using Azure Key Vault and Microsoft Entra ID.
Prepare the technical evidence needed for the release review of AI agents and services, and put agreed controls in place before go-live.
Support the implementation of data protection and security controls for AI solutions, including relevant Microsoft Purview configurations.
Contribute to technical security assessments and incident investigations related to AI workloads.
Configure Power Platform environments and data loss prevention (DLP) policies for Copilot Studio.
Documentation and Collaboration
Maintain technical documentation of Azure AI platforms and solutions, including deployment configurations, integrations, dependencies, operational procedures, data sources and data flows.
Collaborate with AI developers, data professionals and other technical stakeholders to ensure the reliable deployment and operation of AI solutions.
Ensure that AI platforms and workloads align with IFRC's infrastructure, security and operational standards.

Stay up to date with developments in Azure cloud technologies, platform engineering, DevOps and AI operations, and identify opportunities to improve platform reliability, automation, performance, cost efficiency and existing processes.

Experience

added.title: AI Engineer
added.description:
Deliver robust, tested and supportable systems from the team's working prototypes to R&D scientists. The Associate Director is the team's senior full-stack engineer and architect. The role owns the engineering standards, development and deployment patterns, and production readiness for every application the team ships, and decides how software built with agentic tools by scientists and colleagues becomes durable, validation-ready systems. Its decisions set how quickly prototypes become products, how reliable those products are, and whether they are ready for validation. The role partners with a peer Associate Director, AI Platform & Enablement, who turns proven team patterns into shared platform capabilities over time. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role: the Associate Director designs, builds, debugs and reviews production software, working in agentic development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) throughout the day, alongside validated-system work that follows its own procedures.

Responsibilities:

-
Own engineering standards and production readiness for every application the team ships. Select and maintain the team's standard languages, frameworks and supported versions based on security, maintainability, enterprise compatibility and what AI-assisted development builds most reliably. Make architecture, release and incident-response decisions without escalation, within agreed governance, security and quality requirements.
-
Take prototypes built by scientists and colleagues with agentic tools to production grade: refactor, strengthen and productize them with sound architecture, tests, observability, security, documentation and operability. Assess prototypes against agreed engineering standards and work with stakeholders to recommend and implement retain, rebuild or retire decisions.
-
Own application-to-platform integration: the production concerns that recur across applications, such as authentication and single sign-on, secrets, networking, deployment and monitoring. Solve them for the team, build them once into reusable patterns, and work with the AI Platform & Enablement Associate Director and enterprise platform teams to move proven patterns into the platform.
-
Establish and maintain the team's standard development and deployment patterns: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments, starter templates, monitoring and operational runbooks for the team's applications and agents.
-
Own code-review standards and the merge gate for the team's repositories, reviewing and approving changes from scientists, colleagues, contractors and embedded delivery engineers, none of whom report to the role. Run design and architecture reviews before applications enter shared environments, and set the review standard for AI-generated code.
-
Design and build full-stack, cloud-native systems: APIs, orchestration and workflow services, data and vector stores, identity and access, and scientist-facing front ends, favoring managed services and simple, maintainable designs.
-
Partner with Quality and computer system validation colleagues to define and implement risk-based engineering and validation practices for LLM and agent-based applications, and build the evidence case for them. Practices may include requirements traceability, model and configuration change control, regression evaluations, controlled releases and auditable records. Quality retains decision authority.
-
Work directly with R&D scientists and the team's scientists to define software requirements, review their code and build engineering capability through pairing. Lead the productization of the team's flagship applications, directing embedded delivery or professional-services engineers and coaching colleagues on engineering practice.
-
Gain acceptance from platform teams and Cyber for the team's deployment and access patterns. Implement application security practice in line with Cyber standards, and ensure the team's applications and delivery practice comply with the company's quality management system, security guidelines and IT policies.
-
Own the production-support approach for the team's applications, including triage, escalation, incident follow-up and engineering fixes, with support responsibilities agreed across the team and platform partners.
-
Bring production-readiness and risk assessments to senior leadership, with recommendations on build versus buy and on which prototypes to harden or retire.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in a physical, life or quantitative science or in engineering, or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred.
10+ years building and operating production software, with a substantial share as a hands-on architect or principal-level engineer who thinks in systems.
Experience building or operating software in regulated, validated environments (e.g., GxP, computer system validation, IQ/OQ/PQ, requirements traceability) required.
Demonstrated, sustained daily use of agentic development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) to design, build and ship software, with full ownership of generated code, evidenced by delivered software, professional or personal.
Experience owning CI/CD, infrastructure as code and release engineering with a globally distributed team: pipelines, environments, deployment and rollback, and observability.
Track record of taking inherited or prototype code to production grade: refactoring, test coverage, security hardening, performance and operability.
Experience solving the production concerns that sit between applications and platforms (e.g., authentication and SSO, secrets, networking, access control) and turning them into reusable patterns.
Fluency in at least one production language and the judgment to direct agents across a polyglot stack (the team's is Python, TypeScript and PostgreSQL).
Deep cloud-native experience, AWS preferred (equivalent Azure or GCP depth considered): containers and serverless, workflow orchestration, IAM and least-privilege design, managed data stores.
Hands-on LLM application patterns (RAG, vector search, multi-stage pipelines) preferred.
Experience working directly with research scientists preferred.

The Lockheed Martin Artificial Intelligence Center (LAIC) seeks a curious and action-biased AI Adoption Analytics & Data Specialist with a strong background in data engineering, generative AI, and developer enablement. This role blends data pipeline engineering with user and executive storytelling to support enterprise-wide AI transformation. You’ll design and maintain the data infrastructure that powers AI adoption & tokenomics measurement to ensure these solutions deliver measurable impact for Lockheed Martin teams.

Data Pipeline Design & Development

Architect and implement end-to-end data pipelines that ingest, transform, and deliver data from diverse enterprise sources to support AI adoption programs and analytics.
Design ETL/ELT workflows using Python, SQL, Flyte, and/or similar orchestration tools to process structured and unstructured data at scale.
Build and maintain data models optimized for AI/ML datasets, adoption metrics, and executive visualizations.

AI Adoption Analytics & Measurement

Create data infrastructure supporting AI adoption KPIs.
Build pipelines that aggregate and normalize data from Generative AI and other internal AI platforms to provide unified adoption reporting.
Synthesize adoption metrics, developer feedback, and market trends into executive-ready reports and decision packages.
Develop real-time and batch data feeds for leadership dashboards that track AI maturity across business areas and programs.

Data Integration, Governance & Security

Integrate data from multiple internal platforms, HR systems, learning management systems, and AI tools into cohesive, AI-ready datasets.
Document data lineage, maintain data dictionaries, and enforce governance standards across all pipeline outputs.
Collaborate with cybersecurity and IT teams to ensure secure data transfer and storage within on-premises and classified environments.

Community & Ecosystem Development

Serve as a bridge between developers, data teams, product teams, and leadership to ensure alignment on priorities and roadmap.
Contribute to the AI Factory ecosystem by developing reusable data components, integration patterns, and shared services.
Partner with engineering leaders to identify tool and solution gaps, and influence product direction based on developer feedback and adoption data.
Provide technical guidance to junior team members on data engineering best practices.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related STEM field.

Proficiency in Python and SQL for data manipulation, transformation, and pipeline automation.
Hands-on experience with data orchestration tools (Flyte, AirByte, Apache Airflow, Prefect, Luigi, or equivalent).
Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar).
Strong technical understanding of generative AI, developer tools, and modern software development workflows.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to engage both technical and executive audiences.

Desired Skills

Experience with data pipelines in defense, aerospace, or highly regulated industries.
Familiarity with AI/ML data preparation workflows, feature engineering, and training data management.
Experience with streaming data platforms (Kafka, Spark Streaming, or equivalent).
Knowledge of data visualization tools (Streamlit, React, Power BI, or Grafana) for dashboard integration.
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, internal LLMs).
Proven ability to build and sustain technical communities.
Exposure to containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD for data pipeline deployment.

A collective energy and ambition. A place where you can make a real difference.

We’re a company that genuinely cares about our people, our products, our consumers and the environment.

Our unique, informal culture champions courage, determination and collaboration. Knowing we have an open and supportive team means each of us has the freedom to take responsibility and ownership. We have a shared passion to work hard, innovate and push boundaries.

United by the belief that when we strive for growth, anything is possible. While we might not be the largest company in our industry, we believe we can have the biggest impact because: Together We Have the Power to Win.

Job Summary

Church & Dwight is seeking a Data Scientist to join our R&D Agentic Pod team, which is responsible for designing, building, deploying, and scaling AI-powered products that transform how R&D teams make decisions and operate. The Data Scientist, R&D Agentic Pod combines rigorous statistical and machine learning expertise with strong research & development process acumen to solve high-value challenges across consumer insights, product development, packaging, manufacturing processing, quality, and regulatory.

About The Role

The Data Scientist, R&D will develop predictive, prescriptive, optimization, measurement and performance monitoring solutions; translate complex data into practical recommendations; and help embed analytical outputs into decision-support products and AI-enabled workflows.

Working closely with R&D, Quality, & Regulatory stakeholders, AI Champions, GTA partners, analytics leaders, data engineering teams, and AI Engineers, this role contributes across the full solution lifecycle, from opportunity identification and model development through deployment, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.

Success in this role will be measured by analytical rigor, model quality, usefulness of recommendations, user adoption, and measurable commercial impact.

The role sits within the Global Technology and Analytics (GTA) R&D Innovation & AI organization, reporting to the Lead, R&D Agentic Pod.

Work Environment

Hybrid: This is a hybrid role based in Princeton, NJ, and requires in- person attendance on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays, with remote work options on Mondays and Fridays.

Role Accountabilities And Responsibilities

Partner with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, and Consumer Insights teams to frame business questions, define decision criteria, identify high-value analytics opportunities, evaluate and prioritize opportunities based on business value, analytical feasibility, data readiness, scalability, risk, and strategic alignment.
Develop predictive, prescriptive, segmentation, recommendation, propensity, forecasting, causal, experimental, and optimization solutions using structured and unstructured data.
Build, validate, maintain, and monitor machine learning models in Python using scikit-learn, XGBoost, or comparable frameworks.
Define features, assumptions, validation methods, performance metrics, and monitoring plans; assess bias, stability, explainability, failure modes, and business relevance.
Design test-and-learn and measurement frameworks to quantify incremental impact and translate findings into clear recommendations, scenarios, and decision tools.
Create proofs of concept and minimum viable analytical products; embed models and measurement logic into dashboards, applications, agents, and other decision-support experiences.
Partner with AI Engineers, GTA, Enterprise Data Platform, and data engineering teams to productionize solutions and enable reliable, reusable, analysis-ready datasets; identify data quality, coverage, and availability gaps and recommend practical remediation approaches or viable analytical alternatives.
Document methodologies, assumptions, limitations, data lineage, and intended use; ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, security, and responsible AI requirements.
Drive adoption through stakeholder communication, training, reusable best practices, user feedback, and continuous improvement.

Skills And Competencies

Action-oriented, data-driven problem solver focused on measurable outcomes.
Strategic systems thinker with strong technical, business, and product acumen.
Collaborative, curious, and accountable; effective in ambiguity and influencing without authority.

Technical Skills

Statistics and Machine Learning: Probability distributions, hypothesis testing, statistical inference, linear algebra, experimental design, causal measurement, supervised and unsupervised learning, forecasting, and optimization.
Programming and Modeling: Python, SQL, scikit-learn, XGBoost, feature engineering, model validation, explainability, and data preparation and transformation.
Analytics and Decision Support: Data visualization, storytelling, data-driven decision-making, and translation of technical findings into practical recommendations and measurable outcomes.
R&D Applications: Consumer insights, scientific knowledge discovery, formulation optimization, product performance modeling, complaint signal detection, regulatory intelligence, and manufacturing quality and process optimization.
Analytical Product Delivery and Governance: Analytical product thinking, documentation, model monitoring, data quality and governance fundamentals, responsible AI, and reliable decision-support solutions.

Education And Experience

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Econometrics, Analytics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative discipline required.
3+ years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, machine learning, decision science, or a related field required.
Demonstrated experience applying statistics, linear algebra, and machine learning to business problems.
Hands-on experience building and evaluating Python models using scikit-learn, XGBoost, or comparable frameworks.
Experience with SQL, large structured datasets, data preparation, feature engineering, model validation, and translating analysis into recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Econometrics, Analytics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative discipline preferred
Experience with R&D, Quality, or Regulatory datasets and Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG).

Compensation And Benefits

The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $71,000– $101,100. This position is also eligible for a bonus.

As a Church & Dwight US employee, you (and eligible dependents, as applicable) will have access to medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, paid vacation and sick time, and Paid Parental Leave. U.S. employees are entitled to paid holidays, floating holidays, and vacation days starting in their first year of employment depending on hire date. You are also able to participate in our 401k retirement plan (with company match and profit-sharing) and Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan.  

The actual base pay offered to the successful candidate will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal pay parity.  Compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate.

In this role, you will focus on solving complex business problems such as customer segmentation, campaign optimization, churn reduction through a combination of statistical modeling, machine learning, and experimentation. You will work closely with analytics consulting, cross-functional partners, and global delivery teams to translate business questions into analytical solutions, ensuring high-quality and efficient execution across a distributed team model.

As a senior team member, you will guide analytical approaches, ensure rigor and quality, and help evolve procedures while operating within a modern, platform-enabled data science ecosystem.

Partner with business collaborators, analytics consulting, and client delivery teams to define analytical approaches and deliver solutions
Design, develop, and deliver analytics solutions, including segmentation, targeting, and data-driven insights
Apply statistical modeling and machine learning techniques to drive customer-level insights (e.g., churn, CLV, propensity, attribution)
Design and analyze experiments (A/B testing, incrementality, causal inference) to measure marketing effectiveness and ROI
Communicate complex analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Find opportunities to standardize analytics approaches through reusable methodologies and frameworks
Collaborate closely with offshore data science teams, including task prioritization, work allocation, and quality assurance of analytical deliverables
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members, ensuring consistency in methodology, coding standards, and analytical rigor
Apply modern machine learning techniques and leverage emerging capabilities (e.g., Generative AI, advanced experimentation) where appropriate

Qualifications

6–10+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field
Strong foundation in statistical analysis, machine learning, and data modeling
Experience working with large-scale data environments (e.g., Databricks, Spark)
Proven ability to translate business problems into analytical solutions and actionable insights
Experience working with distributed and offshore teams in a global delivery model
Strong experience with experimental design and measurement (A/B testing, causal inference, marketing attribution)
Familiarity with data visualization and storytelling techniques to communicate insights effectively
Experience working with cloud-based data environments (Azure, AWS) and data pipelines is preferred
Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field (PhD a plus)
Hands-on coding experience in Python is required
Exposure to MLOps concepts and model lifecycle management is a plus
Familiarity with Generative AI / LLM applications for analytics and insights is a plus

The Entity Resolution Systems team builds and ships state of the art machine learning solutions to support entity resolution within the enterprise. A core capability that powers a wide range of use cases spanning from marketing to customer servicing, our work has immediate impact across multiple lines of business. We partner with product, tech and design teams to deliver personalized experiences to our data and platform users to drive productivity and innovation. Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation
Leverage Agentic AI tools and workflows to build and test

Position Summary

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join a focused team within SEPS Data Science supporting payment, subscription, and risk experiences across PlayStation’s direct-to-consumer business. This is a hands-on role for someone who can use statistics, machine learning, experimentation, and strong data judgment to help teams make better decisions about how players pay, subscribe, and move through global payment flows. 

This role will be working closely with the Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) Global Payments Team that plays a central role in enabling consumers across the world to purchase hardware, digital content and services.

The initial portfolio is expected to focus on payment method performance, payment flow optimization, subscription payment recovery, and ROI-based evaluation of experiments and business interventions. You will help teams understand customer behavior, payment success, cost and routing tradeoffs, and the business impact of new payment capabilities. 

Our team values practical scientific rigor: clear decision framing, trusted reusable metrics, transparent uncertainty, and recommendations that help teams move faster without sacrificing measurement quality. This role is best suited for someone who can lead ambiguous, high-impact data science initiatives, define analytical direction across multiple workstreams, and translate complex evidence into decisions that shape customer experience and business strategy.

Define experimental, causal-inference, statistical-modeling, and machine-learning approaches for complex decisions with broad business impact.

Honesty, trustworthiness and ethical conduct are material requirements for the responsibilities outlined above

5+ years of professional experience in data science, applied statistics, machine learning, or a related quantitative discipline.
Bachelor’s or advanced degree in a quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
Advanced SQL and Python skills with deep expertise in experimentation, causal inference, statistical modeling, machine learning, and model evaluation.
Demonstrated success leading complex data science initiatives from problem framing through operationalization and impact measurement.
Proven ability to influence senior technical and business stakeholders and elevate data science practices across teams.

Advanced degree in quantitative field.

Our client, a global leader in the pharmaceutical industry, is seeking experienced Real-World Data (RWD) professionals to support therapeutic area-aligned teams in the analysis and interpretation of complex healthcare data. The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience working with real-world healthcare datasets, including claims data and patient-level data (PLD), combined with a strong foundation in hands-on programming and demonstrated experience utilizing AI coding agents.

As the organization evolves its analytical processes, these individuals will leverage AI agents to support code generation and execution while maintaining responsibility for reviewing, validating, and refining outputs. Significant professional experience in pharmaceutical or biotechnology data analytics, real-world data analysis, statistical programming, data science, or a closely related discipline.
Extensive hands-on experience working with real-world healthcare data, including claims data and/or patient-level datasets (PLD).
Strong programming background with demonstrated ability to independently develop, interpret, troubleshoot, and validate analytical code.

agents, including prompting, directing workflows, evaluating generated code, and scrutinizing analytical outputs.

Job Overview

At Arm, our research shapes the future of energy-efficient AI. We build the foundations of tomorrow’s intelligent systems - from next-generation processors and accelerators to cutting-edge ML models and tools. As a Research Scientist, you’ll be part of a global team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible at the intersection of AI, architecture, and scalable compute.

We’re looking for curious, collaborative researchers who want to turn deep technical insights into real-world impact. Whether you’re advancing algorithms for efficient learning, designing ML-friendly compute architectures, or experimenting with new model deployment paradigms - your work at Arm can influence billions of devices worldwide.

We Are Looking For Research Scientists Interested In Foundational Advances At The Intersection Of Machine Learning, Computer Architecture, And Systems, Including (but Not Limited To) The Following Areas

Scalable and Distributed Machine Learning: Approaches for training, inference, and deployment of increasingly capable models across diverse and distributed compute environments.
Efficient and Sustainable AI: Techniques to improve the performance, efficiency, and scalability of machine learning workloads, spanning algorithms, representations, and system-level optimizations.
Generative Modeling: Research into modern generative methods for learning, representation, and synthesis across different data types and tasks.
Multimodal and Integrated Learning: Models and systems that combine multiple sources of information to enable richer perception, understanding, and interaction.
Autonomous and Adaptive Systems: Learning-based methods for reasoning, decision-making, coordination, and adaptation in complex or dynamic environments.
Embodied and Interactive Intelligence: Machine learning approaches for perception, planning, and control in systems that interact with the physical world or with users.

What you could be doing as a Graduate Research Scientist, AI

Your contributions will vary depending on your expertise, but may include:
Investigating novel approaches and applications in machine learning
Exploring how to make machine learning models and workloads more scalable, portable, and power-efficient
Developing proof-of-concepts, prototypes, or simulation environments to test research ideas
Collaborating with teams across Arm to integrate research into products and platforms
Publishing, presenting, or contributing to academic and industrial research communities
Working with partners and ecosystem stakeholders on long-term innovation initiatives

We are looking for individuals who:

A PhD (or equivalent) and strong foundational experience in machine learning, computer science, electrical/computer engineering, or related field.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C/C++, or similar
Experience designing, training, or analyzing machine learning models or systems using standard frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, Hugging Face Transforms, etc.)
Interest in research and long-term innovation beyond immediate product delivery
Contributions to open-source and/or peer-reviewed publications
