Company Description

See how Epsilon powers connected marketing by unlocking the full potential of data and identity.

Overview

Epsilon’s Data Science & AI (DSAI) practice within the Analytics Services team is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to deliver advanced analytics and data science solutions that drive measurable business impact for our clients.

In this role, you will focus on solving complex business problems such as customer segmentation, campaign optimization, churn reduction through a combination of statistical modeling, machine learning, and experimentation. You will work closely with analytics consulting, cross-functional partners, and global delivery teams to translate business questions into analytical solutions, ensuring high-quality and efficient execution across a distributed team model.

As a senior team member, you will guide analytical approaches, ensure rigor and quality, and help evolve procedures while operating within a modern, platform-enabled data science ecosystem.

Responsibilities

Partner with business collaborators, analytics consulting, and client delivery teams to define analytical approaches and deliver solutions
Design, develop, and deliver analytics solutions, including segmentation, targeting, and data-driven insights
Apply statistical modeling and machine learning techniques to drive customer-level insights (e.g., churn, CLV, propensity, attribution)
Design and analyze experiments (A/B testing, incrementality, causal inference) to measure marketing effectiveness and ROI
Communicate complex analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Find opportunities to standardize analytics approaches through reusable methodologies and frameworks
Collaborate closely with offshore data science teams, including task prioritization, work allocation, and quality assurance of analytical deliverables
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members, ensuring consistency in methodology, coding standards, and analytical rigor
Apply modern machine learning techniques and leverage emerging capabilities (e.g., Generative AI, advanced experimentation) where appropriate

Qualifications

6–10+ years of experience in data science, analytics, or a related quantitative field
Strong foundation in statistical analysis, machine learning, and data modeling
Experience working with large-scale data environments (e.g., Databricks, Spark)
Proven ability to translate business problems into analytical solutions and actionable insights
Experience working with distributed and offshore teams in a global delivery model
Strong experience with experimental design and measurement (A/B testing, causal inference, marketing attribution)
Familiarity with data visualization and storytelling techniques to communicate insights effectively
Experience working with cloud-based data environments (Azure, AWS) and data pipelines is preferred
Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field (PhD a plus)
Hands-on coding experience in Python is required
Exposure to MLOps concepts and model lifecycle management is a plus
Familiarity with Generative AI / LLM applications for analytics and insights is a plus

When you join Epsilon, we’ll create something EPIC together.
We’re a global leader in data and identity, with deep expertise in digital media, clean rooms, customer data platforms, loyalty and marketing services. Epsilon operates in 30+ countries across EMEA, the Americas and APAC, with more than 8,000 employees.

Our Culture:

Act with integrity. We are transparent and have the courage to do the right thing.
Work together to win together. We believe collaboration is the catalyst that unlocks our full potential.
Innovate with purpose. We shape the market with big ideas that drive big outcomes.
Respect all voices. We embrace differences and foster a culture of connection and belonging.
Empower with accountability. We trust each other to own and deliver on common goals.

Because You Matter

As an Epsilon employee, you deserve perks and benefits that put you, your family and your finances first. Our benefits encompass a wide range of offerings, including but not limited to:

Extra perks: Comprehensive health coverage, 401(k), tuition assistance, commuter benefits, professional development, employee recognition, charitable donation matching, health coaching and counseling

added.title: Research Scientist/Senior Scientist
added.description:
Company Overview

Balchem is committed to making the world a healthier place by delivering trusted, innovative, and science-based solutions for the health and nutritional needs of the world. Balchem employs approximately 1,400 employees worldwide who provide the service, quality, and technology that enables our customers to win with their customers. We have built a reputation for delivering results to all of our stakeholders. Founded in 1967, Balchem, a Maryland corporation, became a publicly-traded company in 1970 and is listed on Nasdaq under the symbol “BCPC.” Our corporate headquarters is located in Montvale, New Jersey, and we have a broad network of sales offices, manufacturing sites, and R&D centers, primarily located in the U.S. and Europe. The Company consists of three business segments: Human Nutrition and Health, Animal Nutrition and Health, and Specialty Products.

Position Summary

The Research Scientist is a member of the R&D Group based in New Hampton, NY (Temp) Montvale, NJ (Perm). They report to the R&D Manager for Balchem’s Animal Nutrition and Health business. They will participate in a wide variety of projects, with an emphasis on developing new products. They will be expected to take on challenging technical problems and drive research efforts to produce next-generation and breakthrough products. They will develop the scientific data on the lab, pilot plant and commercial scale to progress projects from ideation to scale-up and commercialization.

Essential Functions

Provide hands-on support to lab and pilot plant to fulfill R&D functions, including extrusion, granulation, and fluidized bed operation.
Use expertise in formulation chemistry to create innovative products and improve existing formulations.
Provide creative ideas for expanding our value and profits to our customers and differentiating our company from the competition.
Utilize design of experiments (DOE) to systematically explore multivariate design spaces.
Carefully document projects in an organized and transparent manner.
Become the internal expert, with deep fundamental knowledge of Balchem’s technology such as microencapsulation, spray-drying, agglomeration, and end-use technology rumen-protected nutrients.
Act as a project manager, anticipating challenges to keep projects moving forward.
Review the patent and technical literature and alert the organization to technology developments outside of Balchem.
Work in a multi-disciplinary team to tackle difficult problems harmoniously.
Communicate effectively and interface with other departments to ensure smooth business flow, including Balchem’s Supply Chain and Commercial teams.
Represent Balchem in industry groups and trade associations.
Be an external face for Balchem in the technical community; publish articles, file patents, and make presentations at industry association meetings.
Support product scale-up efforts including infrequent travel to production sites.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements

Combined Education and Experience Requirement:

For the Research Scientist position, a BS degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science, Material Science or Food Science with 4+ years of experience is required. For the Senior Scientist position, an MS degree with 4+ years of experience or a PhD degree with 1+ years of experience is required.

Required Skills

Proven ability to be a safety champion in a process-related industry. Holds self and others accountable for safe behaviors and works toward goal of zero injuries. Ensure that R&D work is conducted in a safe manner via hazard reviews, SOPs, and appropriate PPE.
Preferred professional experience in the specialty chemicals, food, nutraceutical, or pharmaceutical industries or suppliers to these industries.
Mastery of chemistry bench skills and knowledge of or experience with material characterization techniques (DSC, rheology, microscopy, texture analysis, etc.).
Detail-focused working style.
The ability to quickly learn existing protocols and build new protocols to advance projects as needed.
Track record of successful technical execution and publication in peer reviewed journal(s) or patents.
Advanced analytical skills including experiment design (DOE).
Proficiency in data management and analysis, with experience using relevant tools and software.

At NVIDIA, our solutions architects work across product, engineering, sales, developer relations, business development, and partner teams to help customers design, deploy, and optimize AI infrastructure for the energy industry. This role will focus on helping energy accounts from datacenter to the edge adopt NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure for training, fine-tuning, inference, retrieval, and agentic AI and HPC workloads. This is an excellent opportunity to work in an interdisciplinary team at NVIDIA! You will serve as a technical advisor for accelerated systems architecture, GPU and networking systems, cluster design, orchestration, validation, and production deployment for AI data centers and edge environments serving energy customers.

We need a curious, collaborative, and creative individual to advance these opportunities across AI infrastructure, industrial digital twins, and accelerated computing for the energy sector, and to become a trusted technical advisor bridging our industry, infrastructure, and partner teams. What You'll Be Doing

Partner with energy-sector customers, ISVs, and account teams on discovery, architecture reviews, technical deep dives, POCs, benchmarks, demos, and production deployment guidance for AI infrastructure.

Working knowledge of one or more energy sectors (power generation, oil & gas, transmission and distribution / grid, or renewables) and their operational and IT environments.
Excellent presentation, communication, problem-solving, documentation, and collaboration skills.

Description

At Amazon Web Services (AWS), we're looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join the Automotive & Manufacturing organization within AWS Industries. In this role, you'll shape and lead our technology strategy for global automotive and manufacturing customers and partners, acting as a trusted strategic advisor to some of the largest automotive and manufacturing enterprises in the world. You'll drive the creation of long-horizon technology strategies that tackle complex, often ambiguous business challenges—showing customers how cloud adoption can fundamentally reshape their business outcomes and competitive standing.

As a Senior Solutions Architect, you'll serve as both a technical authority and a strategic influencer—bridging technology vision with measurable, long-term business value for automotive and manufacturing organizations. You'll bring deep technical expertise, executive-level business acumen, and the ability to influence technology strategy at the highest levels, engaging C-suite leaders, business decision makers, and senior technical executives to steer the direction of enterprise-scale cloud transformations.

You'll architect solutions to the most complex challenges—breaking down intricate, multi-system problems into elegant, scalable designs that become reference architectures for the broader SA community. You'll pioneer new architectural patterns and industry-specific methodologies (spanning Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI, data platforms, and regulated workloads), and you'll shape the product roadmaps of AWS service teams by translating deep customer insight into clear engineering requirements. Working closely with account management, professional services, support, product teams, and the AWS partner ecosystem, you'll own the strategy for driving broad, lasting AWS adoption across your most strategic automotive and manufacturing enterprise customers.

Key job responsibilities

This role powers the success of AWS's most complex and strategic Automotive & Manufacturing engagements. As a Senior Solutions Architect, you'll own solution programs end to end—from strategy to architecture to customer realization—driving measurable, lasting business impact. You'll operate with full autonomy, applying high judgment to decide where to invest your efforts for the greatest organizational and customer value.

A central part of the role is setting the technical and strategic direction for large-scale transformations—including AI/ML and Generative AI programs, data modernization, and regulated cloud migrations. You'll create reusable reference architectures, methodologies, and thought leadership—whitepapers, frameworks, and prescriptive guidance—that scale your impact across the SA community and the wider automotive and manufacturing market.

You'll act as a strategic advisor to your customers' senior leadership, earning trust at the executive level and shaping their long-term technology and business strategy. You'll anticipate emerging customer needs before they're fully articulated, ask the questions customers haven't thought to ask themselves, and lead the consensus-building required to align large, complex organizations around a clear path forward.

Engineering Transformation is seeking an AI Portfolio Solution Architect to provide technical leadership for the Engineering Generative AI portfolio. This role will shape, build, and continuously improve secure, scalable AI solutions that advance Engineering ways of working.

What You Will Be Doing

In this role, you will serve as the technical authority across a rapidly evolving portfolio of Generative AI and agentic capabilities. You will define architecture, guide full-stack delivery, establish reusable engineering patterns, and ensure solutions are measurable, trustworthy, compliant with Responsible AI Governance and Ethics (RAGE) policies, and ready to scale across Engineering.

Define and evolve the technical architecture, roadmaps, and reference patterns for the Engineering Generative AI portfolio, including agentic workflows, retrieval, orchestration, integrations, and user experiences.
Lead hands-on full-stack solution design and development from prototype through production, spanning front-end applications, APIs, services, data connections, AI models, and deployment pipelines.
Establish composable, interoperable solution patterns with clear interfaces, versioned baselines, traceability, and reusable components across the portfolio.
Define the framework for transitioning rapid, AI-assisted and "vibe-coded" prototypes into mature, enterprise-deployable solutions, including approved development environments, architecture patterns, code quality, security, testing, documentation, ownership, and release criteria.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies, models, frameworks, and vendor capabilities; conduct technical trade studies, prototypes, and recommendations based on mission value, security, cost, performance, maintainability, and RAGE policy compliance.
Design human-centered, human-gated AI workflows that provide transparent outputs, source-grounded evidence, appropriate controls, and auditable decision support.
Embed RAGE requirements into solution architecture, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management; identify and address responsible-AI risks before release.
Partner with Engineering users, Data and AI Enablement, IT Applications, cybersecurity, and platform teams to translate priorities into deployable, supportable solutions.

This role is fully remote. US Citizenship is required due to system access.

Experience with cloud-native architectures, containers, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, event-driven systems, and API management.

Description

Do you want to help education technology companies build what's next with generative AI? Do you enjoy owning the technical relationship with a customer, from the first architecture whiteboard to a production launch at scale? Would you like a seat on a sales team where your technical judgment shapes the plan and the strategy?

Amazon Web Services is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join the EdTech team in the Worldwide Public Sector (WWPS) organization. You'll be the trusted technical advisor to a set of strategic EdTech customers, from fast-growing startups to established learning platforms that serve millions of students and teachers. You'll help them design, build, and scale on AWS, with a focus on bringing generative and agentic AI into their products in ways that are secure, cost-effective, and ready for production.

From idea to IPO and beyond, AWS sets the standard for education technology. The AWS Cloud lets EdTechs build and launch solutions that help students learn every day. You'll work on problems like scaling for back-to-school peaks, building AI tutors and assistants that teachers and districts can trust, protecting student data, and turning years of learning data into products that improve outcomes.

Key job responsibilities

Own the technical engagement for a portfolio of strategic EdTech customers, and be accountable for their architecture decisions and their success on AWS.
Lead generative AI engagements from use case to production, using services such as Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker AI, and Amazon Q, including RAG, agents, evaluation, and guardrails.
Design secure, scalable architectures that meet the privacy and compliance expectations of schools and districts.
Partner with account managers on account plans, and bring a technical point of view to strategy, opportunity reviews, and executive conversations.
Turn what you see across customers into reusable patterns, and bring customer feedback to AWS service teams to influence the roadmap.
Raise the bar for the SA community by mentoring other Solutions Architects, sharing best practices, and speaking at customer and industry events.
Travel up to 25 to 30% to meet with customers and partners.

Key job responsibilities

Execution of a strategic technical account plan for platform adoption (e.g., establish relationships to influence technical stakeholders);
Direct customer interaction to technically qualify and validate sales opportunities (e.g., conduct architecture meetings to validate solution);
Thought leadership engagements to evangelize and advocate for the AWS platform (e.g., public speaking at customer/partner events) ;
Curation and documentation of best practices to accelerate deployments of AWS solutions (e.g., public whitepapers, blogs, code);
Conducting technical enablement for customers/partners (e.g., Immersion Days); and
Capturing customer feedback and demand for evolving the AWS platform.

A day in the life

You might start with an architecture review for a customer launching an AI teaching assistant. Then you build a proof of concept on Amazon Bedrock, and end the day walking a CTO through a plan to cut inference cost before back-to-school. You'll go deep with engineers and stay strategic with executives, often on the same day.

About The Team

EdTech West is a subregion of the North America-based WWPS EdTech organization. The team covers eight territories, each containing multiple customer accounts. Every territory operates with a paired Solutions Architect (SA) and Account Manager (AM).

EdTech and its sister GovTech teams (collectively "xTech") belong to the State and Local Government and Education (SLG/EDU) domain.

Our Customers

EdTech customers are Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) that build and deliver SaaS products for education institutions. Most are private-equity backed commercial companies. They prioritize speed to market, cost control, and product innovation. A large portion of our engagements center on guiding these customers through on-premises-to-cloud migrations and Generative AI adoption.

Industry Rhythm

The education technology industry operates on a seasonal cycle aligned with the academic calendar. Customers deploy their largest application and workload changes during summer months when end-user disruption is lowest. New projects, regional expansions, and application launches occur throughout the year.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

added.description:
Job Description

Roles & Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise AI Architecture

Define end-to-end architecture for Generative AI, Agentic AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation solutions.
Translate airline business priorities into scalable AI capabilities, reference architectures, solution patterns, and implementation roadmaps.
Design reusable AI services across digital channels, airline operations, IT operations, customer service, engineering, and enterprise functions.
Establish architecture standards for model integration, orchestration, data access, APIs, security, observability, evaluation, and deployment.
Review solution designs and ensure alignment with enterprise standards and target architecture.

Generative AI and Agentic AI

Architect enterprise-grade LLM solutions using RAG, knowledge grounding, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration.
Design autonomous and human-in-the-loop workflows with clear controls, approvals, escalations, and auditability.
Define patterns for agent planning, reasoning, state management, memory, function calling, structured outputs, and secure tool access.
Evaluate frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, or equivalent enterprise technologies.
Design reusable components for prompts, tools, workflows, model gateways, evaluation, guardrails, and agent observability.

Airline Business and Operational Solutions

Partner with airline business and technology teams to identify and prioritize high-value AI opportunities.
Architect solutions for digital customer experience, personalization, operational reliability, disruption management, reservations, customer service, employee assistance, major incident management, intelligent IT operations, engineering productivity, and knowledge management.
Design AI capabilities for high-volume, near-real-time, customer-facing, and operationally critical environments.
Balance innovation and speed with availability, reliability, safety, security, and operational stability.

Data, Context, and Knowledge Architecture

Design secure data and knowledge architectures that ground AI solutions in trusted enterprise information.
Define patterns for ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector search, reranking, retrieval, response validation, and knowledge freshness.
Integrate structured, unstructured, streaming, and operational data through enterprise data platforms, APIs, and event streams.
Partner with data teams to ensure quality, lineage, access control, privacy, and governance for information used by AI systems.

AWS Cloud and AI Platforms

Architect AI solutions using Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, OpenSearch, S3, EKS/ECS, Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Kinesis/MSK, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, and CloudWatch.
Evaluate models and services based on quality, security, latency, scalability, portability, reliability, and cost.
Design cloud-native AI platforms that support experimentation, controlled de ployment, enterprise reuse, and model choice.
Integrate third-party and open-source models where appropriate while maintaining enterprise security and governance.

AI Engineering and Integration

Provide hands-on architecture guidance for Python-based AI services, APIs, microservices, and event-driven applications.
Define secure integration patterns for agents to interact with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and operational tools.
Establish standards for schema validation, exception handling, retries, fallbacks, rate limits, and human escalation.
Guide teams in building modular, testable, reusable, and maintainable AI components.

LLMOps, MLOps, Observability, and Production Readiness

Define lifecycle standards for model selection, prompt management, training, fine-tuning, testing, deployment, monitoring, versioning, and retirement.
Establish CI/CD and automated testing for models, prompts, retrieval pipelines, agents, APIs, and supporting services.
Design evaluation frameworks covering accuracy, groundedness, relevance, safety, latency, reliability, operational impact, and cost.
Implement end-to-end tracing and observability for model calls, retrieval decisions, agent execution, tool usage, and failures.
Define production-readiness criteria, rollback approaches, service objectives, support models, and incident-response procedures.

Responsible AI, Security, and Governance

Embed responsible AI, privacy, cybersecurity, compliance, and risk controls into architecture and delivery.
Define identity, authorization, encryption, data isolation, auditability, secrets management, and sensitive-data protection controls.
Implement guardrails for prompt injection, hallucination, data leakage, unsafe output, and unauthorized tool execution.
Ensure traceability and appropriate human oversight for high-impact or operationally sensitive AI recommendations and actions.

Technical Leadership and Collaboration

Serve as a trusted AI architecture advisor to business and technology leadership.
Lead architecture reviews, technical workshops, design sessions, and AI use-case assessments.
Provide clear recommendations on technology selection, implementation approach, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs.
Mentor AI engineers, data scientists, software engineers, and solution architects.
Create reference architectures, reusable patterns, standards, playbooks, and contributions to the enterprise AI roadmap.

We exist to wow our customers. We know we’re doing the right thing when we hear our customers say, “How did I ever live without Coupang?” Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we are collectively disrupting the multi-billion-dollar commerce industry from the ground up and establishing an unparalleled reputation for being leading and reliable force in South Korean commerce.

We are proud to have the best of both worlds — a startup culture with the resources of a large global public company. This fuels us to continue our growth and launch new services at the speed we have been since our inception. We are all entrepreneurs surrounded by opportunities to drive new initiatives and innovations. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day.

Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what’s possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.

Role Overview

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer
for the Coupang Media Group (CMG) - Ads Quality & Ranking
, you will be responsible for designing and deploying state-of-the-art machine learning models, ranking algorithms, and optimization systems powering our advertising platform.
The Coupang Media Group provides vendors and advertisers with high-impact marketing products and services directly within our e-commerce marketplace. Operating at internet scale—handling over 1 billion daily ad impressions—our platform covers complex engineering challenges across real-time behavioral targeting, automated auctioning and bidding, click-through rate (CTR) / conversion rate (CVR) prediction, and search-based advertising. In this role, you will lead the transition of our ad quality stack toward enterprise-grade ML infrastructure and extend our footprint across full-stack ad tech solutions.

What You Will Do

ML System Design & Ads Ranking
Model Development:
Architect, build, and deploy large-scale machine learning and deep learning models to optimize ad targeting, relevance, ranking, and user engagement.
Algorithmic Innovation:
Develop advanced techniques for automated mechanisms, including auto-bidding algorithms, query expansion, and advertiser ROI optimization models.
Marketplace Intelligence:
Design systems that provide actionable suggestions and insights to advertisers, enabling them to identify growth opportunities within the Coupang marketplace.

Architecture & System Scalability
Infrastructure Strategy:
Architect and evolve our end-to-end machine learning platform to serve high-throughput, low-latency ad requests at internet scale.
Technical Quality & Rigor:
Maintain high standards for code quality, system reliability, and automated testing across complex distributed machine learning pipelines.

Leadership & Collaboration
Cross-Team Leadership:
Lead large-scale technical projects spanning multiple engineering teams, aligning technical roadmaps with business objectives.
Mentorship:
Provide technical guidance, code reviews, and architectural mentorship to mid-level and senior engineers.
Cross-Functional Partnering:
Collaborate closely with Product Management, Data Science, and Business Leadership to design and deliver next-generation advertising features.

updated.description:
Standard Job Description

Do YOU have the ability to conceive, design, and build sophisticated control systems from first principles and requirements definition to flight performance validation?

The coolest jobs on this planet… or any other… are with Lockheed Martin Space.

At the dawn of a new space age, Lockheed Martin is a pioneer, partner, innovator and builder. Our amazing people are on a mission to make a difference in the world and every single day we use our unique skills and experiences to create, design and build solutions to some of the worlds’ hardest engineering problems.

Do you want to be part of a culture that inspires employees to think big, perform with excellence and build incredible products? We provide the resources, inspiration and focus - if you have the passion and courage to dream big, then we want to build a better tomorrow with you.

Roles & Responsibilities

Control system design and analysis for precision aerospace mechanisms.
Support programs performing research and product development encompassing multiple engineering disciplines including mechanical, electrical, optics, and controls engineering.
Project support includes design and development of advanced quantum-sensing-based guidance and navigation algorithms; design and development of advanced pointing and stabilization systems for spacecraft, payloads, and next generation large segmented optical telescopes; design and development of controls test beds and related facilities to demonstrate pointing and stabilization system performance, and control system synthesis and analysis.

The ideal candidate will have familiarity with the control of high-bandwidth precision mechanisms through design and test, understand space environments, and work well in a dynamic multi-disciplinary environment.

The ideal candidate will have a PhD in aerospace or mechanical engineering with at least 10 years of professional experience.
Candidate must be a US Person (US Citizen or Green Card holder).

Must be able to communicate effectively with all team members, possess good time management and organizational skills and be willing and able to work in a dynamic and collaborative R&D environment.

Standard Job Description
Performs scientific experiments, investigations, observations and related research studies into the nature and operation of natural phenomena in a particular field, using the scientific methods. Develops theories for understanding, characterizing and organizing natural phenomena into a systematic and meaningful pattern for the benefit of project advancement and emerging technologies. May participate in intellectual property evaluations and development of patent applications. May coordinate interdepartmental activities and research efforts. Proficient in AI prompting as it applies to this position and practice.

Basic Qualifications

Experience in generating Simulink models and performing time-domain and frequency-domain analyses using Matlab's Simulink is required.
Strong background in research and development of control systems for mechanical and electro-mechanical systems, in particular precision mechanisms and guidance & navigation systems applied to aerospace.
Advanced knowledge of classical and state-space optimal control methods as well as knowledge of the state-of-the-art in mechanism technologies.
Knowledge of rigid- and flexible-body dynamics, vibrations, ability to generate and code complex multi-rigid-body dynamics models from first principles in Newtonian mechanics.
Required graduate curriculum include multi rigid-body dynamics and kinematics, vibrations, linear systems theory, classical control, optimal control, digital control, Kalman filtering and estimation, statistics, vector calculus, ordinary differential equations, partial differential equations, numerical linear algebra, numerical analysis.

Desired Skills

A strong interest in control system development and design work, and ability to justify decisions with analysis and simulations based on first principles physics understanding is a must.
Advanced mathematical education and strong analytical skills at the graduate level.
Knowledge of quantum mechanics basics, geometric optics, electro-magnetism, wave mechanics, electro-mechanical systems including motor drive electronics and sensor signal processing, passive and active vibration isolation systems, orbital mechanics.
Desired additional graduate curriculum include electrical circuits, non-linear optimization, convex optimization, robust control, digital signal processing and spectral analysis, calculus of variations, stochastic calculus, numerical integration methods.
Experience with real-time embedded software programming and real-time operating systems is a plus.
